name: axiom-standing
description: Earned trust for agent workers: independent proof checks, a local record, and level-based approval gates. A task is not done until a check passes. Levels only add approvals; L3 is set by the owner alone.

default_level.title: Starting level
default_level.description: Level for an actor with no record yet: L0 read, L1 draft, L2 act. L3 can only be set by you with /standing set.

max_auto_level.title: Highest level a record can earn
max_auto_level.description: Passing checks never promote above this. L1 by default, so proofs alone never grant L2.

promote_after.title: Passes to promote
promote_after.description: Passing checks in a clean window before one automatic promotion.

workspace.title: Workspace folder
workspace.description: L1 and L2 may edit files inside this folder without an extra prompt. Empty means every edit asks.

seed.title: Starting levels by actor
seed.description: Entries like main=L2 or general-purpose=L1. Used only when an actor is first recorded. Actors are main, or the subagent type.

require_proof_on_complete.title: Require a passing check before a task is completed
require_proof_on_complete.description: Refuses TaskUpdate status completed until standing_proof has passed for that task id in this session.

exempt_actors.title: Actors exempt from the completion check
exempt_actors.description: Exact actor names. Exempts only the proof-before-done rule, not the level gate.

file_proof_roots.title: Folders file checks may read
file_proof_roots.description: Absolute folders or files. Empty uses the workspace; with neither, file checks are refused.

http_proof_targets.title: URLs HTTP checks may call
http_proof_targets.description: Absolute http(s) URLs. A path ending in / allows that subtree; otherwise only the exact endpoint. Empty disables HTTP checks.

command_allowlist.title: Read-only commands command checks may run
command_allowlist.description: Exact commands such as git rev-parse HEAD. Words split on spaces; no quotes or shell characters. You must be sure each one only reads.

levels.title: Level map (advanced)
levels.description: Entries like L2=read,local_write,shell,send,spin,unknown. Categories: read, local_write, shell, send, spend, spin, scrub, write, unknown. Leave empty for the defaults.

transcript_line.title: Show a score line in the transcript
transcript_line.description: A dim line after a completion that a check backed, and after a demotion. Claude does not read it.
